description.narrative: The Program will support the fiscal adjustment necessary for Mongolia's economic stabilization program and help to ensure that the budget for social sectors expenditures remains adequate. The Program will protect the poor during the financial crisis by implementing a set of policy measures in the social welfare, health, and education sectors to provide essential social services, and to initiate longer-term reforms to improve the targeting of social assistance and living conditions of the poor, especially in ger areas of Ulaanbaatar.

Pro-poor funding of priority basic services ensured

20% of students in 2011 continue to receive free textbooks and are targeted through PMT (sex disaggregated) Progress/Status: In 2010-2011 school year, MECS distributed free textbooks to 40% of secondary students based on 4 categories. Data Source: MECS financial statistics Actual value:

The benefit level of the Child Money Program per child in 2011 for the lowest socio-economic quintile, at minimum, remains equal to its 2008 level in real terms Progress/Status: CMP was cancelled in Nov 2009 due to Government's decision to abolish National Development Fund and started to distribute wealth from Human Development Fund from Jan 2010. If use the assumption that average family has 3 children then they used to receive together 102,000 tgs quarterly (monthly 3000, quarterly 25.000 for each). Now 3 children receive 63,000 tgs per quarter (21.000 for each). That shows that the benefit has reduced even in nominal terms. Data Source: MSWL 2010 budget and ministerial order Actual value:

Capitation rates in 2011 for Familiy Group Practitioners and Soum Health Clinics remain at least equal to the 2008 level in real terms Progress/Status: The capitation rates for family group practices renewed and approved by the Joint Ministerial Order of MOF and MOH #443, dated 20 Dec 2010. Capitation rate for FGP increased by 20% compare to 2008 level in nominal terms and 4.2% in real terms. Data Source: MOH 2010 budget and joint ministerial order of MOF and MOH Base year: 2008 Baseline value: Y

Targeting of social transfers through proxy means testing becomes Government policy in Ministry of Social Welfare and Labor, Ministry of Health, and Ministry of Education, Culture and Science Progress/Status: Up to date PMT data incomplete with only first round of data. Targeting the poor has been reflected in the Social Welfare Law approved by the Parliament on 19 January 2012. Targeting of textbooks in MECS is still under piloting. The MOH approved the Medicard Program by the Ministerial Order # 427 dated dec 2010 of 2009 to provide targeted medical services for the poor identified by PMT and started to implement from March 2011. Data Source: Ministerial orders of MSWL, MOH and MECS Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N
